sections.Profile:
The "Time Machine" pinball machine, released by Data East in December 1988, offers a nostalgic journey back to the 1950s with its time-travel theme. Designed by Ed Cebula and Joe Kaminkow, the game features vibrant artwork by Kevin O'Connor and Margaret Hudson, and immersive sound and music by David Thiel.

- Years made: 1988
